findings.detail: A section header for senior unsecured notes has blank spread and interest-rate cells and appears to have been treated as a PRIVATE_CREDIT holding, triggering X02.

rationale: X02 flags a PRIVATE_CREDIT row with no interest_rate or basis_spread. In the raw SOI, the localized blank-rate row is a section header, not an investment position: table 15 row 24 reads only 'Senior unsecured notes | (23)' and has empty spread, interest-rate, maturity, cost, and fair-value fields. The actual debt position immediately below this section (Microf, LLC) carries a stated spread and interest rate, so the defect is extraction/classification of a header row as a holding, not a legitimate missing coupon.
